name: SynergySuite
oneLiner: Modular, cloud-based back-of-house platform for multi-unit restaurant chains, covering inventory, purchasing, recipe costing, labor, food safety and reporting, with AI forecasting and ordering.
bestFor: Mid-sized to enterprise restaurant chains and franchise groups that want to standardize food and labor cost control across many locations.

updates.text: Raised $12 million to expand its AI-powered back-of-house platform for restaurant chains and franchise groups.
Playa Bowls (200+ locations) chose SynergySuite to manage food and labor and automate inventory and purchasing.

features: Inventory counts and live stock tracking across locations
AI demand forecasting and suggested (dynamic) ordering
Purchasing, supplier management and invoice handling
Recipe costing and theoretical vs. actual food cost
AI-assisted labor scheduling with time and attendance
Food safety checklists and compliance tracking
Cash management with void and refund controls
Multi-location reporting and POS integrations (including Toast and PAR Brink)

pricing.text: Custom pricing; contact SynergySuite for a quote.

notes: No rename or acquisition found; still independent and sold. The current review's pricing detail (per location per month by module, location-count discounts, one-time implementation fee) is not published by the vendor and could not be confirmed; reduce to 'custom pricing'. Vendor claim of '2-8% savings on food and labor' and Church's '2% food cost savings' are vendor-reported; attribute or omit. One aggregator dated the $12M raise October 2026; it is most likely the August 2025 round re-reported. The vendor also names Costa Vida, Zao Asian Cafe and Fatcats as clients (Utah 100 release, Oct 2025). HR modules mentioned in the current review were not confirmed.
